lines: Sempra is updating its full-year 2026 GAAP earnings-per-common share (EPS) guidance range to $7.41 to $8.41, reflecting strong results through the third quarter, guiding to the high end of its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range of $4.80 to $5.30 and affirming its 2027 EPS guidance range of $5.10 to $5.70.
▪estimated gain on sale of SI Partners ranging from $2.00 billion to $2.40 billion, subject to post-closing adjustments, which we expect to complete in November 2026

desk.headline: Adjusted EPS up 26% to $1.40, beat; 2026 seen at top of $4.80–5.30 range, 2027 range affirmed
results: Revenue edged up 1% to $3.2bn; adjusted EPS rose to $1.40 from $1.11 and GAAP EPS to $1.34 from $0.12, when a large tax charge hit.
Texas (Oncor) earnings rose to $460m from $306m as Oncor set a record peak demand of 33.3GW, up 6%.
California earnings fell to $223m, hurt by $149m of after-tax charges from proposed regulatory decisions, which are excluded from adjusted results.

About $10bn of capital was invested in the first nine months; the Ecogas Mexico sale closed in August and the 45% stake sale in Sempra Infrastructure Partners to KKR affiliates is due to close within two weeks.
Oncor expects its 2027–2031 base capital plan to be about 20% bigger than the current plan; Sempra's full plan comes in February.

guidance.summary: Sempra kept its 2026 adjusted EPS range of $4.80–5.30 and now expects the high end. It affirmed 2027 EPS of $5.10–5.70, but warned a pending California rate ruling could put it in the lower half. GAAP 2026 guidance was updated to $7.41–8.41, mostly for the expected gain on the infrastructure stake sale.

points: Texas demand growth was called remarkably strong; data centres are the largest source, but other customers also add a lot.
Oncor's $47.5bn five-year base capital plan is expected to rise about 20% on customer and load growth.
The CFO called the California rate-case setback a one-year issue tied to about $188m of 2027 revenue; Sempra will keep challenging the proposed decision.
The CEO urged California lawmakers to act on wildfire liability reform, calling the lack of a bill a problem.

watch: Closing of the Sempra Infrastructure Partners stake sale and how the cash is used.
Final California ruling on the 2027 rate adjustment, which could pull 2027 EPS into the lower half.
The full 2027–2031 capital plan due in February 2027.

sources.title: Sempra expects 20% increase to Oncor's spending plan, driven by load growth — Utility Dive, 6 Nov 2026
